summary: Multi-Profile System testing complete. All 20 backend API tests passed. Frontend Profiles tab UI verified working with CRUD operations, profile editor modal, playlist selection, and tip visibility toggles. Short URL redirects working for both single and two-segment paths. 404 page displays correctly for unknown slugs. Existing /musician/:slug route unchanged (zero breaking changes).

integration_issues.issue: When 'All Songs' checkbox is selected in profile editor, it saves 'all_songs' as playlist ID which doesn't exist in database, resulting in 0 songs. This is expected behavior per spec - empty active_playlist_ids returns 0 songs. Users should select real playlists.

critical_code_review_comments: Profile CRUD endpoints properly validate slug format (lowercase, numbers, hyphens only)
Slug uniqueness enforced within musician's profiles on both create and update
Delete restriction correctly prevents deletion of only profile
Public profile endpoint returns merged musician + profile data with songs from active playlists
Short URL redirect component correctly resolves slugs via /api/resolve/{slug}
Existing /musician/:slug route unchanged - shows all 11 songs
Profile tip visibility settings (show_tips_in_success_screen, show_tips_in_orientation) correctly stored and returned
seed_data_creation: Created test profiles during testing (cleaned up by test suite)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Multi-Profile System fully tested and working. Backend has 20 passing tests covering: Profile CRUD, slug validation, public resolution, request with profile context, delete restrictions. Frontend Profiles tab shows profile cards with Copy URL, QR, Edit, Delete buttons. Profile editor modal has name, slug, playlist checkboxes, and tip visibility toggles. Short URL redirects work for /:seg1 and /:seg1/:seg2 patterns. 404 page shows for unknown slugs.

backend: POST /api/profiles - Create profile with slug validation
GET /api/profiles - List all profiles for authenticated musician
DELETE /api/profiles/{profile_id} - Refuse deletion of only profile
GET /api/musicians/{master_slug}/{profile_slug} - Public endpoint with songs from active playlists
GET /api/resolve/{slug} - Slug resolution for short URL redirects
POST /api/requests with profile_slug - Stores profile_id on request
frontend: Profiles tab shows profile list with cards and CRUD actions
Profile editor modal with name, slug, playlists, tip toggles
/musician/:slug (existing) still shows all songs - zero breaking changes
Short URL redirect /:seg1 -> /musician/:seg1 when slug found
Short URL redirect /:seg1/:seg2 -> /musician/:seg1/:seg2 when slug found
